records.source_original: General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
records.where_description: Pokrovsk direction,  the areas of the settlements of Yelizavetivka, Promin, Lysivka, Kotlyne, Udachne, Uspenivka, Novooleksandrivka, Novoserhiivka, Kotlyarivka, Oleksiivka, Andriivka. Six clashes are still ongoing. The enemy's aviation carried out airstrikes with KABs on the areas of the settlements of Pokrovsk, Oleksandropil, Grodivka, Sukhyi Yar, Novopavlivka, Novoukrainka, Zvirove, Leontovychi, Oleksiivka.
